objective: Authorize one bounded formal evaluation-only pilot that loads the eight declared checkpoints produced by the verified training pilot and proves the four learning paths can execute, verify, and reproduce V2 metrics without retraining.
context: This is an eight-cell evaluation matrix: paired evaluation cells for Q-learning/C3, DDQN/C3, DDQN/GAT, and DDQN/MPNN.
Every checkpoint path, checkpoint SHA, sibling metadata SHA, source lineage identity, code SHA, configuration SHA, and immutable M-Lab trace is bound before launch.
The paired cells are checkpoint/execution consistency checks. They do not authorize algorithm superiority, causal congestion claims, or final paper statistics.
allowed_inputs: The exact clean main commit containing this matrix and its accepted finalization
excluded_inputs: Training outputs whose checkpoint or metadata SHA is not bound by this matrix
Any claim that treats this evaluation pilot as algorithm superiority, causal congestion evidence, Q0 optimality, or final paper statistics
deliverables: A machine-recomputed authorization decision bound to the eight evaluation cells, exact checkpoint artifacts, and this accepted work finalization
One natural-end VM receipt per evaluation cell with checkpoint-loaded evidence, conservation, data/control delivery, and resource metrics
A V2 analysis artifact that recomputes the four paired evaluation contrasts from raw receipts, plus persisted verification
cannot_claim: This pilot does not establish that any algorithm is better than another.
This pilot does not establish a causal congestion-control mechanism, a final E0 threshold, Q0 optimality, or paper-ready statistical generalization.
A run that retrains, silently falls back, or loads a checkpoint without the declared source SHA cannot be counted as an evaluation result.
acceptance: The authorization binds the exact compiled request, run manifest, analysis request, resolved configs, checkpoint bytes, sibling metadata, clean deployed main SHA, and this finalization.
All eight cells run serially on the same deployed SHA and immutable M-Lab-derived trace identity, with learning.mode=eval and zero training steps.

Each cell has natural_end=true, conservation=true, research_eligible=true in the governance receipt, exact loaded checkpoint SHA/metadata SHA, required control/data delivery, peak RSS, CPU/thread count, and wall time.
The four planned paired evaluation contrasts are recomputed from raw artifacts and persisted verification returns ok=true with no errors.
If any cell fails a gate, execution stops at that cell and the matrix is not treated as complete until the failure is repaired and the affected cell is rerun.
